subject: Acme Retail POC — outcomes snapshot & 30s customer clip ask

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Retail POC — outcomes snapshot & 30s customer clip ask

Hi Daniel / Asha,

Huge thanks again — the 30-day POC wrap went really smoothly and the results look strong on both sides. I pulled together a short outcomes snapshot (attached) but wanted to call out the headline metrics here so you have them at-a-glance: 

• Average end-to-end inference latency improved from ~280ms to ~85ms (3.3x faster)
• Per-token serving cost decreased ~42% after batching + KV cache
• Peak throughput observed: 2.6x baseline during simulated Black Friday traffic (sustained for 6 hrs)
• Error/timeout rate dropped from 0.9% to 0.1% with fallback routing in place

These gains are exactly what you asked for in terms of latency and cost predictability — congratulations to your team.

We'd love to feature Acme in a short customer highlight: two asks that are quick and low-friction if you're open: 
1) A 1–2 sentence blurb (email reply is fine) describing the impact you saw and how you might use Redwood in production.
2) A quick 30‑second audio clip (phone or Zoom recording) where a product/ops lead says the same two lines. We can take care of editing and approval before publish.

If you prefer, we can do a 15–20 minute call next week to capture the clip — we’ll bring a short script so it’s painless. Marcus and Vivek can handle the technical questions if anything comes up during the call.

Attached is a one‑pager (acme_poc_kpis.pdf) and a suggested 30s script (redwood-30s-script.txt) so you can see how little effort this will take. If you’re happy, could you: 
• Reply with a 1–2 sentence blurb or 
• Tell me a good time for a 15–20 minute recording next week and who from Acme will join?

Thanks again — we really appreciate the partnership and the tight collaboration on the POC.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the concise summary and the docs. The numbers match what our internal dashboard shows; the latency and cost wins are real and made a noticeable difference during our traffic spike test.

We’re happy to help. Asha and I can provide a 1–2 sentence quote: "Redwood's runtime dropped our inference latency by over 3x while cutting serving cost—enabled us to scale without compromising response time." We’ll polish it and confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Asha and I can also do a quick 20 minute recording on Wed 22 May at 10:30am PT. That works for our schedule. If you want a product person as well, loop in Marcus.

One note: please attribute the quote to Acme Retail (A. Menon, Head of Product) and specify the test was run against our staging traffic.

Daniel
